scientific_integrity: Unconditional theorem for the frequency distribution over sampled positive integers, not an assertion on individual Artin-prime infinitude. The estimated Euler constant uses an outward-rounded exact-integer interval for the rational partial product and an elementary tail bound.
scientific_limitations: The uniform relative asymptotic is proved only for cutoffs below one-quarter of the sample logarithm; no optimality assertion is made for the range or for any individual base. Generic squarefree sieve coverage remains a possible literature overlap.
title: A persistent squarefree bias in least-primitive-root-prime tails
